title: Website Live Chat
description: Built for local service businesses. Most visitors leave your website without saying a word. Live chat catches them in under 2 seconds — before they move on to someone else.
alt: Website live chat and visitor messaging

faqs.question: Does the live chat connect to SMS?
faqs.answer: Yes. When a visitor leaves a message in the web chat widget, CasperPortal captures their phone number and routes the conversation to SMS. This means you can reply from your phone, and the customer receives your reply as a text message after they've left your website.

faqs.question: Can I automate responses in the live chat?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You can set up automated greetings, FAQ responses, or even an AI bot to qualify the lead and book an appointment directly through the chat widget.

title:
Reputation
Management
description: One bad review can undo months of great work. Take control of your online reputation by collecting more positive reviews and responding before damage spreads.
alt: Online review and reputation management platform

faqs.question: How does automated review collection work?
faqs.answer: When you mark a job as 'Complete' or a customer as 'Won' in the CRM, CasperPortal automatically triggers an SMS and email sequence asking the customer about their experience and providing a direct link to your Google Business Profile to leave a review.

faqs.question: Can I dispute negative reviews through the platform?
faqs.answer: While you cannot directly delete a customer's Google review from the platform, CasperPortal alerts you instantly when a negative review is posted. This allows you to respond quickly, resolve the issue, and often successfully ask the customer to update their rating.

title: Facebook Messenger
description: Unanswered social messages tell customers you don't care. Pull every Facebook conversation into your CRM so nothing gets buried and no one feels ignored.

faqs.question: Why should I connect Facebook Messenger to my CRM?
faqs.answer: Customers often reach out on the platform where they found you. By centralizing Facebook messages into your CRM, you ensure that social leads are tracked, followed up, and moved through your sales pipeline just like web leads.

faqs.question: Can I automate replies on Facebook?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can set up automated greetings and FAQ responses for Facebook Messenger, ensuring that even after-hours inquiries get an immediate response.

title: Google Call Tracking
description: You're spending money on ads but have no idea which ones actually ring your phone. Track every call to its source so you stop wasting budget on what isn't working.
alt: Google Business Profile call tracking software

faqs.question: How does call tracking help me save money on ads?
faqs.answer: By assigning unique tracking numbers to different ad campaigns, you can see exactly which keywords or ads are driving phone calls. This allows you to cut spending on non-performing ads and double down on what works.

faqs.question: Do I lose my original business number?
faqs.answer: No. Tracking numbers simply forward to your existing business line. Your main number stays exactly as it is, while the tracking numbers provide the data you need to optimize your marketing.

title: Missed Call Text Back
description: For contractors and field service teams. Instantly text back missed calls in <5 seconds so they know you're on it — even when you can't pick up the phone.

faqs.question: How fast does the missed call text go out?
faqs.answer: The text message is sent within 5 seconds of the call ending or going to voicemail. This speed is critical to catch the customer before they dial the next business on their Google search results.

faqs.question: Can I customize the missed call message?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can fully customize the text message. A common template is: 'Hi, this is [Your Business Name]. We're currently assisting another customer, but how can we help you today?'

faqs.question: Does this work with landlines?
faqs.answer: Landlines cannot receive text messages, but CasperPortal can provide you with a local tracking number that forwards to your landline. When someone calls the tracking number and you miss it, the system will text their mobile phone back.

title: Text To Pay
description: Chasing payments is exhausting and awkward. Send a text, they tap to pay — done. No more uncomfortable follow-ups or waiting weeks for a check.
alt: Text to pay payment collection software

faqs.question: Is text-to-pay secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. CasperPortal uses industry-standard encryption and partners with secure processors like Stripe to ensure every transaction is safe for both you and your customer.

faqs.question: What is the fee for text-to-pay?
faqs.answer: CasperPortal does not charge additional transaction fees. You only pay the standard processing fees from your connected payment provider (e.g., Stripe's 2.9% + 30¢).

title: Memberships

faqs.question: Can I host video courses in the membership area?
faqs.answer: Yes. CasperPortal's membership area is perfect for hosting training videos, documents, and resources for your clients or team.

faqs.question: Can I charge a recurring subscription for access?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You can set up monthly or annual recurring billing that automatically grants or revokes access based on payment status.

title: Lead Capture Forms
description: Interested people visit your site every day and leave without a trace. Capture their name and number before they disappear so you can follow up while intent is high.
alt: Online forms and lead capture software

faqs.question: Can I embed these forms on my existing website?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can easily embed CasperPortal forms on WordPress, Squarespace, Wix, or any other platform with a simple copy-paste code.

faqs.question: Do forms connect to the CRM automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every form submission instantly creates a contact record and can trigger automated follow-up sequences.

title: Customer Surveys
description: Guessing what your customers want is a gamble you lose slowly. Ask them directly with simple surveys — then use what they tell you to keep them longer.

faqs.question: How do surveys help my business grow?
faqs.answer: Surveys provide direct feedback on what you're doing right and where you can improve. They can also be used to qualify leads or gather data for case studies.

faqs.question: Can I automate survey delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can trigger a survey to be sent via SMS or email immediately after a service is completed or an appointment ends.

title: Trigger Links
description: Generic marketing gets ignored. Trigger links track exactly what each person clicks so your next message feels personal — like you read their mind.

faqs.question: What is a trigger link?
faqs.answer: A trigger link is a special link that, when clicked, automatically performs an action in your CRM, such as adding a tag, moving a lead to a new pipeline stage, or starting an automation.

faqs.question: How do trigger links improve conversion?
faqs.answer: They allow you to segment your audience based on their actual interests. If a lead clicks a link about 'Plumbing Repair,' you can automatically send them more relevant info about that specific service.

title: SMS & Email Templates
description: Rewriting the same message ten times a day drains your energy. Save your best-performing texts and emails as templates so every response is fast, sharp, and consistent.

faqs.question: Can I use custom values in templates?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can automatically pull in the contact's name, your business name, appointment times, and more, so every message feels personal even though it's a template.

faqs.question: Do you provide pre-written templates?
faqs.answer: Yes. CasperPortal comes pre-loaded with high-converting templates for common local business scenarios like follow-ups, reminders, and review requests.

title: Automation Triggers
description: Manually following up with every lead isn't scaling — it's surviving. Set triggers that fire the right action at the right time so your business runs even when you don't.

faqs.question: What triggers an automation?
faqs.answer: Triggers can be anything from a form submission, an incoming call, a link click, a tag being added, or even a customer's birthday.

faqs.question: Can I set delays between actions?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can set precise delays (e.g., wait 2 hours, wait 3 days) between different steps in your automation sequence.

faqs.question: Can I schedule campaigns in advance?
